actions.unfold_garment: Open or spread a previously folded or bunched garment.
actions.position_garment: Place, rotate, align or reposition the garment for the task.
actions.smooth_garment: Smooth or press fabric flat without making a new fold.
actions.flip_garment: Turn the whole garment onto its other face, rather than rotating it on the table.
actions.fold_side: Fold an identifiable side panel of the garment body inward.
actions.fold_lengthwise: Fold the garment body with the crease parallel to its clearly identifiable long axis.
actions.fold_crosswise: Fold the garment body with the crease across its clearly identifiable long axis.
actions.fold_section: Make a visible fold whose part or orientation is not established; describe the observed fold specifically. Never use this as an episode-wide fallback.
actions.adjust_folded_garment: Align, tuck or press the already folded result without another distinct major fold.

episode.unit: One independently started and completed folding attempt on one garment; repeated attempts on the same garment may be separate episodes.
episode.start: First observed task-directed placement, opening, positioning or handling for this attempt. Do not invent missing onset evidence.
episode.end: End of the last task-directed fold or final adjustment after completion is supported. Hands may remain in contact. Exclude subsequent static holding, resting, idle time, phone operation and mere removal of the finished garment.
episode.boundary_precision: Use real supplied frame anchors and retain necessary task context. A small unresolved exact-cut choice is a boundary note, not automatically an image-review issue.
episode.phone_interruption: Mark the affected task REVIEW; do not splice disjoint spans into a complete accepted task. Other tasks continue.
episode.incomplete: Preserve an observed unfinished task as INCOMPLETE. Missing or conflicting evidence about episode bounds, task identity or completion is REVIEW, not proof of completion.
episode.internal_label_gaps: When episode bounds, continuity and completion are supported, uncertain internal action labels may remain explicitly unlabeled. Preserve each interval, reason and source evidence; this alone does not block acceptance or downstream hand/export/publication. Do not use a label gap to hide a phone interruption or uncertainty about task completeness.

execution.normal_path: One recording-wide text review using existing Qwen outputs; accept supported episodes after program validation.
execution.image_review: Only for a material, explicitly identified question unresolved by existing text. Inspect a bounded evidence packet, not every episode by default.
execution.short_actions: Keep a supported action's actual positive duration, including durations below 1.5 seconds. Merge only when evidence establishes a genuinely continuous compatible operation, never to satisfy a duration threshold. Duration alone is not an issue or a reason to block an episode. If only the internal action label is uncertain, record an unlabeled span instead of inventing a name, stretching time or escalating the entire episode.
execution.specificity: Sleeve and side-panel codes take precedence over generic body-fold directions. Use fold_section when an observed fold is clear but its direction is not. Do not open an image issue solely to obtain a more specific name.
execution.supplementation: Text review may recover an action explicitly described in a Qwen description despite a vague action code. An entirely new visual observation requires inspected image evidence.
execution.uncertainty: Empty Qwen uncertainties are not a quality guarantee. Check chronology, completion, identity and contradictions; do not infer unseen content.
execution.camera_scope: Record actual available camera topics. Never claim three-camera review from single-camera evidence. Request a missing view only when it is necessary to resolve the concrete issue.
